'''Zakuulan rebels''' were citizens of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]] who opposed the [[Eternal Empire]] during the [[war against Zakuul]]. They later joined the [[Eternal Alliance]] and its [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] after the [[Grand Festival of Empress Vaylin]].
